description: This file is a server entry point for a Remix-based web application, handling HTTP requests and rendering responses with server-side React rendering, including support for bots detection and CORS headers.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler function that sets CORS headers and delegates request handling based on user-agent detection.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles rendering for bot traffic using React server-side streaming, resolves with a Response containing the streamed content.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles rendering for browser traffic similar to bot handler, with server-side streaming mechanism.
